references.source_file: Kulish (1905) Bible text — ebible ukr_pan, public domain

note: Take Root API is egress-blocked from this container (curl to api.takeroot.bible returns 000). The Kulish text was fetched instead from the ebible mirror on raw.githubusercontent.com (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/ukr_pan), all 66 books, and every span below was lifted from it byte-for-byte rather than typed.

John 19:30 — «Звершилось» — the cry from the cross, the phrase on which his conversion turned. Kulish renders 'It is finished' as a single word, which is why the surrounding sentence carries the sense the English spreads over three.
Also filed under #884, a duplicate of this job.
